name: @adhd/sox-hybrid-search
description: Generic hybrid retrieval ranker — fuses vector similarity + text relevance signals (mechanism-agnostic: textScore / vecScore) via normalized RRF/max-score fusion. SearchBackend interface decouples ranking logic from storage. StoreSearchBackend wires VectorBackend + GraphBackend via DI. Pure fuse() + normalize() functions are exported for callers with any signal source.

concerns: SearchBackend interface (mechanism-agnostic: textScore / vecScore, not BM25 / cosine)
pure fuse() + normalize() exports (no storage dep)
explain mode (signal-level breakdown only — not field-level)
SchemaAdapter is SQLite-internal (NOT exported — filters wired into StoreSearchBackend)

vector-channel filter parity (BL-294) — StoreSearchBackend resolves query.filters through graph.queryNodes() and constrains vec.knn() to the matching id set, so namespace/kind/topic/projectPath/agentId filters scope BOTH channels identically, not just the text channel

degrade signal (BL-294) — SearchBackend.search() results carry an additive degraded?: { unsupportedFilters: string[] } field whenever query.filters included a key with no NodeFilter mapping; surfaced unconditionally on SearchResult, not gated behind explain
invariants: SearchBackend.search() degrades to text-only when query.vec is absent, degrades to vec-only when query.text is absent — never errors on a missing signal
scores are normalized BEFORE combining (never raw scale-blind additive merge)
textScore / vecScore are mechanism-agnostic names — BM25 / cosine are implementation details inside backends (never surfaced through SearchBackend interface)
SchemaAdapter is an internal SQLite concern — NOT exported; MCP handlers pass raw filters via SearchQuery.filters; StoreSearchBackend resolves them internally
fuse() weights must be multiplicative (field boosting), never additive (scale-blind)

a NodeFilter that matches zero nodes yields zero vector candidates — never an unfiltered knn() fallback (a PRESENT-BUT-EMPTY VecFilter.ids means "match nothing", never "no filter": a scope that resolves to zero candidates yields zero results at every layer — BUG-032 / ADR-0017)

the pure surface (fuse/normalize/rrfFuse) and StoreSearchBackend over injected backends resolve NEITHER @adhd/sox-vector-store NOR @adhd/sox-embedding-provider; the cross-encoder is the only path that resolves embedding-provider, and only on first createCrossEncoder() — both are optionalDependencies loaded lazily (ADR-0019)

externalConsumers.name: @adhd/backlog
externalConsumers.note: hard dep on hybrid-search; lists the heavy two as optionalDependencies
